title: Matrix Factorization Framework for Community Detection under the Degree-Corrected Block Model
abstract: arXiv:2601.06262v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Community detection is a fundamental task in data analysis, and block models provide an approach for identifying diverse community structures. The degree-corrected block model (DCBM) is an established model that captures node degree heterogeneity. However, inference methods are computationally costly and sensitive to initialization, while cheaper alternatives, such as spectral or modularity-based approaches, may be less effective at recovering certain non-assortative structures. In this work, we show that DCBM inference can be reformulated as a constrained nonnegative matrix trifactorization problem. Leveraging this insight, we propose a scalable community detection method with a theoretically grounded initialization providing an initial partition for inference algorithms. translated_title: 度校正块模型下社区检测的矩阵分解框架
translated_abstract: 社区检测是数据分析中的一项基础任务，块模型为识别多样化的社区结构提供了一种途径。度校正块模型（DCBM）是一种成熟的模型，能够刻画节点度的异质性。然而，其推断方法计算代价高昂且对初始化敏感，而谱方法或基于模块度的方法等更经济的替代方案，在恢复某些非同配（non-assortative）结构时可能效果不佳。在本工作中，我们证明DCBM推断可以被重新表述为一个带约束的非负矩阵三因子分解问题。借助这一洞察，我们提出了一种可扩展的社区检测方法，该方法具有理论支撑的初始化，可为推断算法提供初始划分。我们的方法与网络结构无关，适用于任何可用DCBM表示的图。在合成网络与真实世界基准网络上的实验表……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将度校正块模型（DCBM）的推断重新表述为带约束的非负矩阵三因子分解问题，据此提出了一种具有理论初始化、可扩展且适用于任意DCBM网络的社区检测方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates DCBM inference as a constrained nonnegative matrix trifactorization problem, yielding a scalable community detection method with theoretically grounded initialization applicable to any DCBM-representable network.
